title: Practice 4: Мне нравится, нужно, надо, можно

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Как бы по ___ (ветер) было пущено несколько чрезвычайно развязных понятий.
exercises.why: The logical subject, that is the person who has to do something, is in the dative case: *Надо идти в класс.* The logical subject, when used with **можно** or **нельзя**, is in the dative case: *Вам можно курить, а мне нельзя. Отцу нельзя пить вино, а брату можно.* The person who needs something (or someone) is in the dative case. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 35, 36, 41, 66.  ·  «The person who needs something (or someone) is in the dative case … The logical subject, when used with можно or нельзя, is in the dative case.» «This verb (нравиться) is used with the agent in the Dative case and the object (of the liking) in the Nominative case.» — DLI, Lessons 35, 36, 66.
exercises.context: The logical subject, that is the person who has to do something, is in the dative case: *Надо идти в класс.* The logical subject, when used with **можно** or **нельзя**, is in the dative case: *Вам можно курить, а мне нельзя.
